plan: With a high private value of $48, my goal is to win the auction while minimizing my payment. Since this is a single round with no prior history, I'll use a strategic bid close to my value but not exactly matching it. I want to signal strength but not overpay. A bid around 80-90% of my value seems optimal - this gives me a good chance of winning while preserving potential profit margin.

In a single-round sealed bid auction, my optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value to maximize potential profit. Since this is a one-shot game with no repeated interactions, I'll bid strategically close to, but under my true value. A bid around $37.5 allows some profit margin while being competitive. With uncertainty about other bidders' values, I want to balance winning probability with potential profit.

With a private value of $12, my goal is to maximize potential profit. In a sealed bid auction with two other bidders, I want to bid strategically. Since the value is randomly drawn, I'll aim to bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. A bid around $10-$11 gives me potential profit if I win, while protecting against overpaying. The key is balancing the chance of winning with minimizing potential loss.
